title: Asymptotic stabilization of weak solutions to phase-field equations with non-degenerate mobility and singular potential
summary: A common paradigm in phase-field models with singular potentials is that global-in-time weak solutions converge to a single equilibrium only after undergoing asymptotic regularization. However, in arXiv:2510.17296 we introduced a novel method to establish the convergence to a single equilibrium for solutions to Cahn--Hilliard equations, and some related coupled systems, with non-degenerate mobility and singular potentials, under very general assumptions: we only require the existence of a global weak solution satisfying an energy inequality and then we make use of a Lojasiewicz--Simon…
